metaTitle: Custom Hanes Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Hanes lanyards and badges in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for events, schools, and corporate branding.
introHtml: Hanes lanyards and badges combine the trusted quality of Hanes apparel with custom branding options for your team or event. Whether you're outfitting staff with branded ID holders at a conference or creating uniform accessories for a retail team, Hanes offers durable materials and a range of colors that coordinate with their popular T-shirts and hoodies. Choose from woven or printed lanyards with metal or plastic clips, and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom Hanes lanyards and badges with printed logos, featuring durable clips and adjustable straps.
